 8 1/4" x 10 3/4", full page ad. New York: Paillard Incorporated (1960). 
 This magazine advertisement pictures an illustration of the Bolex D-8L camera and proclaims to measure "all 9 types" of movie exposures: 1) Wide Angle. 2) Telephoto. 3) Slow Motion. 4) Zoom Shots 5) Comic Speed-ups. 6) Backlighting Effects. 7) Fades. 8) Color. 9) Black and White.
